prompt: Output the integers from 1 through 200 in ascending order, separated by one space. Output only the integers.

protocol.ttft_definition: request submission to first non-empty generated content
protocol.memory_definition: CUDA driver device-used memory delta from the post-context baseline, sampled after warmup and after measured requests

excluded_claims: Results apply only to the recorded model, request shape, software, and hardware.
Single-request measurements do not establish concurrent serving throughput.
Device memory deltas are steady-state observations, not process-private, allocator, or system-wide peaks.
The benchmark does not qualify CUDA Graphs, prefix caching, speculative decode, tensor parallelism, multiple GPUs, or multiple streams.
